text:
Anya (People Ops): Hey team — quick FYI about the upcoming Q2 performance review cycle. Key dates below, please RT if you manage a team or are an IC with direct reports.
Jordan (Eng): Thanks! Can you paste the form link here?
Anya (People Ops): Sure — feedback forms + self-review are in the Performance Hub: https://intranet.redwood.ai/perf-q2-2026 (access: all employees). Deadlines: self-reviews due Apr 10, manager reviews due Apr 17, calibration Apr 22–24, final ratings locked Apr 26.
Matt (Eng-Platform): Are calibrations distributed by org or cross-org?
Anya (People Ops): Cross-org panels this cycle for engineering and infra. We kept product and sales separate. Calibration invites will go out by EOD next week.
Priya (Manager): For managers who miss the manager-review deadline, what's the fallback?
Anya (People Ops): If you miss Apr 17, your review will be paused and escalated to your manager's manager. Please avoid — it delays comp and growth conversations. If you need an extension, DM me with the list of people and new target date; we can approve on a case-by-case basis.
people-ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: Self-review due in 7 days (Apr 3). Use /perf help in Slack for FAQs.
Jordan (Eng): Is there a condensed form for ICs with <1 year tenure? My new hires joined in Jan.
Anya (People Ops): Yes — the "Short-form" for <6 months or new hires is auto-applied. If you think someone should be on the full cycle despite tenure, flag it in the manager form checkbox.
Priya (Manager): What's the format for calibration packets? Raw ratings + 1-paragraph rationale?
Anya (People Ops): Calibration packet = rating, competency tags (ownership, craft, impact), and 2–3 bullet evidence lines. We want succinct rationales to keep panels moving. Example snippet:
```
Rating: Exceeds Expectations
Competencies: Ownership, Cross-team Impact
Evidence: Led rollout of KV cache, reduced 95p latency by 18% (deploy 2026-02).
```
Sam (Recruiter): Heads-up: we have two internal candidates up for promo that week — can we avoid assigning them to calibrators who are on their interview loop?
Anya (People Ops): Good catch. Sam, DM me the names and I'll mark them as conflict-of-interest for those reviewers.
Matt (Eng-Platform): Any updates on calibration rubric changes? I remember a tweak to the "scope" vs "depth" language.
Anya (People Ops): Yes — we clarified "scope" to mean "impact breadth (teams/customers)" and "depth" as "technical mastery or ownership depth." Full rubric is attached in the hub, and there is a 30-min optional rubric walkthrough on Apr 8 (calendar invite sent).
Jordan (Eng): Will the review forms ask for compensation recommendations?
Anya (People Ops): Managers will be able to input a comp band suggestion, but final comp decisions are processed separately by People Ops + Finance after calibration. Managers: provide an evidence-based suggestion; do not promise increases during calibration.
Priya (Manager): Can we run a dry-run for new managers? I have two first-time managers who want guidance on writing evidence bullets.
Anya (People Ops): Yes — we have a 45-min "Manager Writing Clinic" on Apr 6. Sign-up link is in the hub. Extra office hours available Apr 11–15.
people-ops-bot: Calibration invites sent to panelists: 40 users. Check your calendar.
Jordan (Eng): Perfect — thanks Anya. Will nudge my team on the self-review deadline. :thumbsup:
Anya (People Ops): Thanks all — ping me for any access issues. Also, if anyone wants the CSV export template for bulk manager inputs, say the word and I’ll drop it here.
Matt (Eng-Platform): CSV template pls.
Anya (People Ops): Dropping CSV template: https://intranet.redwood.ai/perf-templates/q2-manager-bulk.csv. Use the header exactly; bulk upload opens Apr 12.
Sam (Recruiter): Noted, will avoid scheduling interviews during Apr 22–24 calibration window for affected teams.
Priya (Manager): Appreciate the clarity.
people-ops-bot: Thread archived in 30 days unless updated.
